<issue>
KCD XML indentation broken after recent changes

#### Description

The XML indentation in KCD format output is incorrect. When dumping a database to KCD format, the indentation levels are not properly calculated, resulting in malformed XML structure.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# Load a KCD file and dump it back to string
db = cantools.database.load_file('tests/files/kcd/dump.kcd')
kcd_output = db.as_kcd_string()
print(kcd_output)
```

The output shows incorrect indentation where nested XML elements are not properly indented relative to their parent elements. For example:

Expected:
```xml
<NetworkDefinition>
  <Document version="1.0" />
  <Node id="1" name="Node1" />
    <Bus name="Bus">
      <Message id="0x001" name="Message1" length="5">
        <Producer>
          <NodeRef id="1" />
        </Producer>
      </Message>
    </Bus>
</NetworkDefinition>
```

Actual:
```xml
<NetworkDefinition>
<Document version="1.0" />
<Node id="1" name="Node1" />
<Bus name="Bus">
<Message id="0x001" name="Message1" length="5">
<Producer>
<NodeRef id="1" />
</Producer>
</Message>
</Bus>
</NetworkDefinition>
```

The indentation appears to be using a fixed value instead of properly scaling with the nesting level.
</issue>
